sentences.speaker: D
sentences.english: Good morning, team.

sentences.speaker: D
sentences.text: Les mando el horario del viaje del sábado.
sentences.english: I am sending you the schedule for Saturday's trip.

sentences.speaker: D
sentences.text: Vamos a una finca cerca del pueblo para visitar a una familia.
sentences.english: We are going to a farm near the village to visit a family.

sentences.speaker: K
sentences.english: When do we leave?

sentences.speaker: K
sentences.english: How many are going?

sentences.speaker: D
sentences.text: Salimos a las seis de la mañana, de la terminal.
sentences.english: We leave at six in the morning, from the terminal.

sentences.speaker: D
sentences.english: Eight are going.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Yo traigo el café y el pan.
sentences.english: I will bring the coffee and the bread.

sentences.speaker: L
sentences.text: Yo traigo la caja con los libros.
sentences.english: I will bring the box with the books.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: Yo traigo unas camisetas para los niños.
sentences.english: I will bring some T-shirts for the children.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: Quiero regalar una a cada niño.
sentences.english: I want to give one to each child.

sentences.speaker: K
sentences.english: How nice!

sentences.speaker: K
sentences.english: Are there animals on the farm?

sentences.speaker: K
sentences.text: Quiero ver las vacas y los caballos.
sentences.english: I want to see the cows and the horses.

sentences.speaker: L
sentences.english: There are cows, horses and hens.

sentences.speaker: L
sentences.english: There is also a big dog.

sentences.speaker: K
sentences.english: I am going to take photos.

sentences.speaker: D
sentences.english: Very good.

sentences.speaker: D
sentences.text: Después compartimos las fotos en el grupo.
sentences.english: Afterwards we will share the photos in the group.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: Good day.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Hoy es martes, y trabajo en la clínica hasta las cinco.
sentences.english: Today is Tuesday, and I work at the clinic until five.

sentences.speaker: L
sentences.text: Los martes yo tengo reunión con el pastor, pero hoy llego tarde.
sentences.english: On Tuesdays I have a meeting with the pastor, but today I am arriving late.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: Yo estudio con Carlos los martes y los jueves.
sentences.english: I study with Carlos on Tuesdays and Thursdays.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: I cannot go today.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: Daniel, I have a question.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: What shoes do we need for the farm?

sentences.speaker: D
sentences.english: Old shoes.

sentences.speaker: D
sentences.english: There is a lot of dirt.

sentences.speaker: K
sentences.english: I do not have old shoes.

sentences.speaker: K
sentences.english: Who will lend me some?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Yo te presto unos el jueves.
sentences.english: I will lend you some on Thursday.

sentences.speaker: K
sentences.english: Thanks, Ana.

sentences.speaker: K
sentences.text: Te prometo devolver los zapatos el domingo.
sentences.english: I promise to return the shoes on Sunday.

sentences.speaker: K
sentences.english: I will keep my word.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Para el culto del domingo voy a usar un vestido azul.
sentences.english: For Sunday's service I am going to wear a blue dress.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: And you, Sam?

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: Una camisa blanca y mi pantalón negro.
sentences.english: A white shirt and my black pants.

sentences.speaker: L
sentences.text: ¿Quién tiene una pelota para los niños?
sentences.english: Who has a ball for the children?

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: I have an old ball.

sentences.speaker: K
sentences.text: Yo llevo flores para la mamá de la familia.
sentences.english: I will take flowers for the mother of the family.

sentences.speaker: D
sentences.text: La reunión del equipo es el miércoles a las siete.
sentences.english: The team meeting is on Wednesday at seven.

sentences.speaker: D
sentences.text: Les mando un correo con el horario.
sentences.english: I will send you an email with the schedule.

sentences.speaker: D
sentences.english: Good day.

sentences.speaker: D
sentences.text: Hoy es miércoles, y tengo una noticia.
sentences.english: Today is Wednesday, and I have some news.

sentences.speaker: D
sentences.text: Un vecino de la finca me contó que anoche hubo truenos.
sentences.english: A neighbor from the farm told me that last night there were thunderclaps.

sentences.speaker: D
sentences.text: Un rayo cayó en un árbol.
sentences.english: A bolt of lightning fell on a tree.

sentences.speaker: D
sentences.text: Hubo un incendio pequeño, pero los vecinos escaparon.
sentences.english: There was a small fire, but the neighbors got out.

sentences.speaker: D
sentences.english: There were no accidents.

sentences.speaker: K
sentences.english: What a fright!

sentences.speaker: K
sentences.english: Is there danger for us?

sentences.speaker: D
sentences.text: Si hay inundación en la calle, el autobús no puede llegar.
sentences.english: If there is a flood in the street, the bus cannot get there.

sentences.speaker: L
sentences.text: Yo oí en la iglesia que viene un huracán a la playa.
sentences.english: I heard at church that a hurricane is coming to the beach.

sentences.speaker: L
sentences.english: But it is far away.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: Daniel, I do not see the email.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: Please look in the group.

sentences.speaker: D
sentences.english: Sorry.

sentences.speaker: D
sentences.english: I will look at it now.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: Daniel, ¿me explicás cómo llegamos a la finca?
sentences.english: Daniel, can you explain to me how we get to the farm?

sentences.speaker: D
sentences.english: I will explain in the email.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: Yo pienso que es mejor esperar.
sentences.english: I think it is better to wait.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: ¿Cuándo vamos a saber si vamos o no?
sentences.english: When are we going to know whether we go or not?

sentences.speaker: D
sentences.english: Tomorrow I will let you know.

sentences.speaker: D
sentences.text: Voy a hablar de nuevo con el vecino.
sentences.english: I am going to talk to the neighbor again.

sentences.speaker: L
sentences.english: Thanks, Daniel.

sentences.speaker: L
sentences.english: I am very grateful to you.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: El miércoles por la noche tengo culto, así que mañana leo todo.
sentences.english: On Wednesday night I have a service, so I will read everything tomorrow.

sentences.speaker: D
sentences.english: Good day, team.

sentences.speaker: D
sentences.text: Hoy es jueves, y ya tengo noticias del vecino.
sentences.english: Today is Thursday, and I already have news from the neighbor.

sentences.speaker: D
sentences.text: Llovió mucho, y un árbol cayó en la calle.
sentences.english: It rained a lot, and a tree fell in the street.

sentences.speaker: D
sentences.english: We cannot go on Saturday.

sentences.speaker: D
sentences.text: Vamos el domingo, cuando acaba el culto.
sentences.english: We will go on Sunday, when the service ends.

sentences.speaker: K
sentences.english: That is fine.

sentences.speaker: K
sentences.text: Entonces el domingo traigo la comida.
sentences.english: Then on Sunday I will bring the food.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: ¿Quieren compartir el autobús con la otra familia?
sentences.english: Do you want to share the bus with the other family?

sentences.speaker: D
sentences.english: Yes, that is fine.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: Today Luis turns thirty.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: Happy birthday, Luis!

sentences.speaker: K
sentences.english: Happy birthday!

sentences.speaker: L
sentences.english: Thank you all.

sentences.speaker: L
sentences.english: I am grateful for your messages.

sentences.speaker: K
sentences.english: Daniel is not answering his phone.

sentences.speaker: K
sentences.english: Who knows where he is?

sentences.speaker: D
sentences.english: Sorry, I could not answer.

sentences.speaker: D
sentences.english: I was at the church.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: Karla, here are the shoes.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Te presto los zapatos hasta el domingo.
sentences.english: I am lending you the shoes until Sunday.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: We are already on the bus.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: El autobús se rompió, pero Carlos lo arregló.
sentences.english: The bus broke down, but Carlos fixed it.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.english: It was a small scare.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.english: Now everything is fine.

sentences.speaker: K
sentences.text: Yo voy a enseñar una canción a los niños.
sentences.english: I am going to teach the children a song.

sentences.speaker: L
sentences.text: Y yo voy a enseñar un juego.
sentences.english: And I am going to teach a game.

sentences.speaker: L
sentences.english: I saw the email, Daniel.

sentences.speaker: L
sentences.english: Thanks.

sentences.speaker: K
sentences.text: Los niños abrieron la caja y gritaron: ¡Camisetas!
sentences.english: The children opened the box and shouted: T-shirts!

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Una niña lloró cuando probó la camiseta.
sentences.english: A girl cried when she tried on the T-shirt.

sentences.speaker: L
sentences.text: Un perro tomó una camiseta y escapó.
sentences.english: A dog took a T-shirt and ran away.

sentences.speaker: L
sentences.english: Everyone shouted.

sentences.speaker: K
sentences.english: The family offered us tamales.

sentences.speaker: K
sentences.text: Yo les mostré una canción, y los niños cantaron.
sentences.english: I showed them a song, and the children sang.

sentences.speaker: K
sentences.english: Now I am on the farm.

sentences.speaker: K
sentences.text: Los niños me preguntaron mucho, y yo les respondí contenta.
sentences.english: The children asked me a lot, and I answered them happily.

sentences.speaker: D
sentences.text: Sam, mandá las fotos al grupo.
sentences.english: Sam, send the photos to the group.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.english: I am sharing them now.

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: Aquí están: la vaca, el caballo, las gallinas y los niños con las camisetas.
sentences.english: Here they are: the cow, the horse, the hens and the children with the T-shirts.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Yo recuerdo los cuentos de mi abuelo.
sentences.english: I remember my grandfather's stories.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Hoy no los voy a olvidar.
sentences.english: Today I am not going to forget them.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.english: I listened to the children.

sentences.speaker: C
sentences.english: They sang very well.

sentences.speaker: K
sentences.text: Hoy vi la luna y las estrellas en el autobús.
sentences.english: Today I saw the moon and the stars on the bus.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: And the animals?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.english: How were they?

sentences.speaker: S
sentences.text: La vaca grande miraba a los niños, y una gallina caminaba por la mesa.
sentences.english: The big cow watched the children, and a hen walked across the table.

sentences.speaker: K
sentences.text: ¡Y el caballo comía las flores de la señora!
sentences.english: And the horse ate the lady's flowers!

sentences.speaker: D
sentences.english: Thanks to everyone.

sentences.speaker: D
sentences.english: We got it all done.
